{{Quote|I am General Gurveer, commander of the Third Battalion, and I'm taking it upon myself to win House Panteer's allegiance to the Empire.|Gurveer|<ref name="Savior" />}}
[[General/Legends|General]] '''Gurveer''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served the [[House of Thul]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
In [[3643 BBY]], Gurveer was stationed on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] during a [[Alderaan Civil War|civil war]]. He made a report to a citizen of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] that [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]] had offered to help the [[House Panteer]] to fight against the [[House Ulgo]]. The [[General/Legends|General]] wanted to neutralize House Organa's support so that House Panteer would turn to [[House of Thul|House Thul]] and the Empire for assistance.<ref name="Savior" />

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
